review:
Monkey's Gold xPays is a 6x6 jungle slot. xPays triggers when symbols land next to each other on the first three reels: non-winning symbols vanish and drop again, and wins grow as more symbols connect.

Colossal 2x2 and 3x3 symbols can carry multipliers up to 500x, with wilds filling any gaps beneath them. Filling a whole row upgrades the collected symbols. Nolimit rates it Medium volatility, with a 12,683x cap.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
